overview: The Beach Club is a Deluxe resort styled after a New England seaside hotel. You can walk to Epcot's back entrance, and it shares Stormalong Bay, a famous sand-bottom pool area, with the Yacht Club.
suits: Families and Epcot fans who want a walkable Deluxe resort with one of the best pools on property.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep five with a daybed in many rooms. Views range from standard to lagoon views.
pools: Stormalong Bay is a three-acre pool area with a sandy bottom, a shipwreck waterslide and a lazy river, shared with the Yacht Club.
dining: Cape May Cafe hosts a character breakfast, and Beaches & Cream Soda Shop is known for its giant sundaes.
cons: Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
Rooms can be a long walk from the lobby
tips: Walk to Epcot's International Gateway for a quiet entrance near the World Showcase.
Beaches & Cream is small, so book ahead.
bestFor: Families and Epcot fans who want to walk to the park.
